Emerald Dual Screen for Android %1$s

An Android port of Pokémon Emerald 3Ds Dual Screen by ZallaxDev (MIT licence), github.com/ZallaxDev/pokeemerald-3Ds-dualscreen, which compiles unchanged on top of a re-implementation of the 3DS libraries.

Built on the pret/pokeemerald decompilation (github.com/pret/pokeemerald).

Contains code from devkitPro libctru, citro3d and citro2d (zlib licence).

Engine-only builds require a data pack generated for the same Android build using your own cartridge dump. Development builds may embed game data.

This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures or The Pokémon Company. Pokémon and Pokémon Emerald are trademarks of their respective owners.
Optional speed, shiny odds, experience and save helpers
Every option starts off. Preferences stay separate from your Emerald save; Pokémon and progress still use the original save format.
R2 toggles; hold L2 or keyboard Tab. A toggle also appears in the pause menu. Audio is muted while fast-forwarding.
Shiny odds for new wild encounters
Healthy benched Pokémon below level 100 receive half base EXP. Existing participant and held Exp. Share rewards stay unchanged. Eggs are excluded.
